title: Escalated cases
transcript:
Consultant: How does a case get escalated?
Client: Someone shouts in the team channel. That is the process.
Consultant: And in the CRM?
Client: Nothing. We need an escalated checkbox on the case so the manager
queue can filter on it.
Consultant: A simple yes or no.
Client: Yes or no. We do not need levels, we tried that before and nobody used it.

expected.note: Checkbox on Case; client explicitly rejects a more complex design.
